description.value:
As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can strike up an enhanced song lasting up to 1 minute, ending it early whenever you like with no action required. While playing, you gain a new use for your Potent Aptitude determined by the song (below).

Taking damage while performing forces a Constitution save to keep playing, with a DC of 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher; damage from separate sources each demand their own save. While playing, a damage-dealing tech power you cast that would normally call for an attack roll or a saving throw can instead be made to deal sonic damage — if you do, it requires a Constitution save in place of its usual attack roll or save. Your song also ends early if you're incapacitated, die, or stop holding the instrument.

You can strike up an enhanced song twice, regaining all uses after a short or long rest.

Song of Battle. When an ally within 60 feet who can hear you deals damage to a creature, you can use your reaction and one use of your Potent Aptitude to add the die's result to that damage.

Song of Support. When an ally within 60 feet who can hear you makes a saving throw against a harmful effect, you can use your reaction and one use of your Potent Aptitude to add the die's result to that save.

Song of Disruption. When an enemy within 60 feet who can hear you makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction and one use of your Potent Aptitude to subtract the die's result from that save.
